brief:
The Al-Ahrar movement accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of arrogance and said his stance confirms that the Israeli occupation is betting on military escalation rather than diplomatic solutions, Shehab Wire reported. The Palestinian political faction rejected what it characterized as Netanyahu's rejection of peaceful settlement in favor of prolonged conflict.

The statement emerged as tensions remained high across the region. Al-Ahrar's criticism reflects broader Palestinian political opposition to Israeli leadership's negotiating posture and its apparent preference for military operations over substantive peace talks. The movement's comments underscore deep divisions over the conditions and possibility for any resolution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.
title: Hamas says Netanyahu bets on war over negotiations.
